title: Delta-K: Boosting Multi-Instance Generation via Cross-Attention Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2603.10210v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While Diffusion Models excel in text-to-image synthesis, they frequently suffer from catastrophic concept omission when generating complex multi-instance scenes. Existing training-free methods attempt to resolve this by rescaling attention maps, which merely exacerbates unstructured noise without establishing coherent semantic representations. To address this, we propose Delta-K, a backbone-agnostic, plug-and-play inference framework that resolves omission by operating directly in the shared cross-attention Key space. Utilizing a lightweight Vision-Language Model (VLM) preview, we isolate a differential key ($\Delta K$) capturing the pure semantic signature of missing concepts, and proactively inject it during the early semantic planning phase. Governed by a dynamically optimized scheduling mechanism, Delta-K grounds diffuse noise into stable structural anchors while naturally preserving existing concepts via the inherent ortho

translated_title: Delta-K：通过交叉注意力增强提升多实例生成
translated_abstract: 虽然扩散模型在文本到图像合成方面表现出色，但在生成复杂的多实例场景时，经常遭受灾难性的概念遗漏问题。现有的免训练方法试图通过重新缩放注意力图来解决这一问题，但这只会加剧非结构化噪声，而无法建立连贯的语义表示。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Delta-K，一个与主干网络无关、即插即用的推理框架，它通过直接在共享的交叉注意力Key空间中操作来解决概念遗漏问题。利用轻量级视觉-语言模型（VLM）的预览，我们分离出一个差分Key（ΔK），它捕获了缺失概念的纯语义特征，并在早期语义规划阶段主动将其注入。在动态优化的调度机制控制下，Delta-K将扩散噪声锚定为稳定的结构锚点，同时通过固有的正交性自然地保留已有概念。
tldr: Delta-K提出了一种与主干网络无关、即插即用的推理框架，通过在共享交叉注意力Key空间中分离并主动注入缺失概念的差分Key，有效解决扩散模型生成复杂多实例场景时的灾难性概念遗漏问题。
